notes: region_enumerate only scans region coordinates -32..31 (chunks -1024..1023). Gates not re-run. write's chunk timestamp is netherite.oracle.Oracle.saveClockMillis() / 1000 (the save clock pin, lane/rerecaudit). The disk half is n/a (lane/idxworld): every save this game makes is the oracle's (a checkpoint's save, session.sh's Save and Quit through Java: AGENTS.md 'Playing a full game'), and the native engine reads what it wrote (region.c for the overworld's region files, the snapshot's saved chunks for DIM-1 and DIM1, structures.json, villages.nbt, worldinfo.nbt, player_server.nbt); writing those files natively is the deferred product work of the 2026-09-25 triage (SPEC.md NEXT, '11 deferred save-writing'; out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md, 'Deferred, not noise'). Within a session nothing reads a save back: an unloaded chunk waits whole in the in-memory region store (sr_store_chunk) with what writeChunkToNBT keeps of it (the entities it saves, in section order; the pending ticks relative to the world time), and a reload restores exactly that (the persist-* and play-reload recordings). region_enumerate scans region coordinates -32..31 (chunks -1024 to 1023 blocks x 16): a save's chunks lie within the ground the recordings walk.
